image_description: A tabby cat lying on its back on a beige carpet, exposing its belly. The cat has grey and black striped fur with white patches on the chest and paws. Its head is tilted back, looking towards the viewer with wide yellow-green eyes. All four limbs are visible, splayed out in a relaxed pose.
